subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Describe, compare and order up to 5 objects
source.subtopic: Compare collections of objects: many, fewer, most, least (weeks 1-2); more than, less than (weeks 3-4, 9-10); the same as, just as many, different (weeks 5-8)

show.line: Look! This plate has many sweets. That plate has fewer sweets. Many and fewer.

rounds.praise: Yes! Five is more than two.
Yes! One is fewer than four.

rounds.prompt: Count the birds on the wire. How many?
Many or few? Put each picture in its group.

hints: Count each group. The bigger number is more.
Fewer means a smaller number. Least means the smallest of all.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the bowl with fewer apples.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This one! Five apples is fewer.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Two is fewer than five.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. Two apples, five apples. Two is fewer!

parent_line: Can compare groups of objects using many, fewer, most and least.
